notes.title: DAY ONE PATCH (Part 1) v. 1.00.02
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you for playing the game. I'm glad you're enjoying it. However, there were—and still are—some issues and bugs. That’s why I’m here to fix them. Stay tuned!

[h2]Optimization Fixes (first 5 levels updated):[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted lighting settings.
[*] Reduced polygon count for background objects.
[*] Removed minor background elements.
[*] Updated texture rendering settings.
[/list]

[h2]Minor Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The settings menu can now be accessed from combat locations.
[*] Vertical sync is now enabled by default to reduce GPU load.
[*] The startup screen can now be skipped using the mouse (previously, only keyboard keys could be used).
[/list]

tags.balance_change: - Reduced polygon count for background objects.

tags.feature: - The settings menu can now be accessed from combat locations.
- Vertical sync is now enabled by default to reduce GPU load.
- The startup screen can now be skipped using the mouse (previously, only keyboard keys could be used).

notes.title: HOTFIX DEMO #3 (v.0.36.17)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we're releasing a small patch that addresses the most common issues players have encountered. Feel free to report any bugs in the appropriate [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2698460/discussions/0/4360122114351828486/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]thread[/url].

We are continuing to work on further fixes and patches, and thank you for playing Shift'n Slay!
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] The timer is now disabled by default. If you'd like to expand your gameplay experience, you can enable the timer at the terminal in the hub.
[*] Added edge panning. You can now move the camera by moving the cursor to the edges of the screen.
[*] Updated the lighting in locations 1-3 and improved performance.
[/list]

tags.feature: The timer is now disabled by default. If you'd like to expand your gameplay experience, you can enable the timer at the terminal in the hub.
Added edge panning. You can now move the camera by moving the cursor to the edges of the screen.
Updated the lighting in locations 1-3 and improved performance.

notes.title: UPDATE DEMO #2 (v.0.28.06)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877840/df7cd2b75dab04ef1ab5c7a207ceea852a5032c1.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,

Today we've added the ability to choose difficulty levels. The difficulty level affects what equipment and how much of it your character will have. We've also introduced a new character (Scum Junkie) and a new battle location (Narco-Laboratory) into the game. Additionally, we've made several minor changes to the game.

You can still report any errors you encounter in the appropriate [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2698460/discussions/0/4360122114351828486/]thread[/url].

[h3]UPDATES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added difficulty level selection.
[*] Added a new stimulant - 'Quick Step'.
[*] Added a new opponent - 'Scum Junkie'.
[*] Added a new battle location - 'Narco-Laboratory'.
[*] Updated attack, damage, and death sounds for the main character.
[*] Updated the leaderboard. It now displays your position on the list.
[/list]
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed minor localization issues. 
[*] Fixed an issue with status display after the character's death. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the display of attack areas for melee characters.
[/list]

Added a new opponent - 'Scum Junkie'.
Added a new battle location - 'Narco-Laboratory'.
Updated attack, damage, and death sounds for the main character.
Updated the leaderboard. It now displays your position on the list.

notes.title: HOTFIX DEMO #1 (v.0.27.05) NOW LIVE!

We continue to work on further fixes and patches, but in the meantime, thank you for playing I am the Law!
